description: This file contains SwiftUI extension methods for the ChannelsSettings class, providing UI components for managing channel settings including WhatsApp and other channels, with functionalities such as login, logout, refresh, and configuration editing.

methods.name: formSection
methods.description: Creates a stylized section with a title and content view.

methods.name: channelHeaderActions
methods.description: Provides action buttons for a channel, such as logout and refresh.

methods.name: whatsAppSection
methods.description: Constructs the WhatsApp-specific UI section including linking, QR code display, and relink options.

methods.name: genericChannelSection
methods.description: Creates a configuration section for a given channel.

methods.name: configEditorSection
methods.description: Provides UI for editing and saving a channel's configuration.

methods.name: configStatusMessage
methods.description: Displays the status message related to configuration.
